event_data.continuation_prompt:
CYCLE 2 MISSION: Validate and harden the 5 Activity log bug fixes applied in Cycle 1 to the AtlasForge dashboard. The fixes were applied to: dashboard_v2.py, af_engine.py, dashboard_static/js/chat.js, dashboard_static/src/chat.js.

CYCLE 2 OBJECTIVES:

1. FUNCTIONAL VALIDATION - Run the actual dashboard (dashboard_v2.py) and af_engine.py together. Trigger a suggestion event from af_engine.py and verify end-to-end:
   - The suggestion message appears in the Activity log within 5 seconds
   - The message is styled distinctly (not the same style as regular user/assistant messages)
   - The provider value shows as 'system' or 'suggestion' correctly in the UI

2. VERIFY ALL 5 FIXES ARE INTACT:
   a. In dashboard_v2.py: watch_chat() emits to existing clients BEFORE adding to seen_messages (pre-seeding order)
   b. In dashboard_v2.py: watch_chat() uses history[-30:] not history[-10:]
   c. In dashboard_v2.py: _normalize_provider() preserves 'system' as valid type
   d. In dashboard_static/js/chat.js: socket.on('message') passes provider/display_role as 4th arg to addMessage()
   e. In af_engine.py: suggestion events use 'system' or 'suggestion' as provider value

3. CHECK FOR REGRESSIONS - Verify normal user/assistant messages still appear correctly styled after the changes.

4. SCREENSHOT VERIFICATION - Use vision_tool.py to capture a screenshot of the dashboard with the Activity log showing a suggestion message styled distinctly. Save to /tmp/cycle2_verification.png and read it to confirm visually.

5. If any fix is missing or broken, re-apply it. If all fixes are confirmed working, document the final validated state in workspace/artifacts/activity_log_fixes_validated.md.

cycle_report.summary: Cycle 1 applied all 5 identified Activity log bug fixes across the dashboard backend (dashboard_v2.py, af_engine.py) and frontend (dashboard_static/js/chat.js, dashboard_static/src/chat.js). The fixes addressed: watch_chat() pre-seeding order (emit before marking seen), poll window expansion from history[-10:] to history[-30:], _normalize_provider() updated to preserve 'system' as valid provider type, legacy socket.js message handler updated to pass provider/display_role metadata as 4th argument to addMessage(), and af_engine.py updated to emit 'system' or 'suggestion' as a recognized first-class provider type. End-to-end validation was performed to confirm suggestion messages appear styled distinctly in the Activity log.
achievements: Fix 1: watch_chat() now emits pre-seeded messages to existing connected clients BEFORE adding to seen_messages set, so reconnecting clients receive missed messages
Fix 2: watch_chat() poll window expanded from history[-10:] to history[-30:] to match REST API window size, preventing message gaps

Fix 3: _normalize_provider() in dashboard_v2.py now preserves 'system' as a valid provider type (not coerced to unknown), with corresponding UI style added for system/suggestion messages in the Activity log
Fix 4: Legacy dashboard_static/js/socket.js socket.on('message') handler updated to pass provider and display_role metadata as 4th argument to addMessage(), enabling correct styling
Fix 5: af_engine.py updated to emit 'suggestion' as a first-class provider value, fully recognized through the normalization and styling pipeline
End-to-end validation: suggestion triggered from af_engine.py and confirmed to appear with distinct styling in Activity log within 5 seconds
issues: watch_chat() startup pre-seeding pattern was absent from dashboard_v2.py in some code paths - required careful inspection to locate correct insertion point
Mirror sync required between dashboard_static/js/chat.js and dashboard_static/src/chat.js (both must be kept identical as one is the source and one the build output)
